rules.censoring: produced, unresolved values of a censored run at its stopping round - t_end
rules.excluded: unproduced values (no t_end when the run stopped)
rules.tail: constant hazard: events / rounds at risk at ages >= H*, from the key if M_MIN are at risk at H, else its (d, level) pool

provenance.note: Lambda, the age at which a value's decoded outcome arrives, per decode-latency class: a Kaplan-Meier estimate that keeps the censored values, with a constant-hazard tail (Section 5.2). Fitted on the seed-1 training runs listed in sources, made with the compiled recovery-script library (--library sx) and two ordinary rounds per H round (--h-depth 2).
